properties.name: The reasons-lost scan added to loop_status in #781 costs an owner-scoped loop_status no more than half again what it cost before
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-10-20 ("go with your suggestion": stop the speed work in phase 6 PR 4, record the slowdown as a follow-up)
properties.statement: loop_status, plain and scoped to one owner, costs no more than 1.5x what it did on main before #781 (48f28651) on the full reflow2 design with a release build. MEASURED 2026-10-20 (release build, median of 3): plain 1.37 s -> 1.47 s (fine); scoped to who:ajs 1.10 s -> 2.07 s (1.9x, over); graph_report 1.80 -> 1.83 s; reviewed_gaps 6.83 -> 7.45 s. The extra cost is the reasons-lost scan (what has lost its reason now). A follow-up, kept out of phase 6 on Anthony's word so the phase's features are not held up by about one second on one scoped call.
